$comment: Gate-clause wiring register. Seeded 2026-08-25 from the E0..E11 exit-gate audit.
wired   = a production path reaches the named symbol; the checker verifies it and fails on 0.
unwired = honestly dormant; reason must say what would have to change. Reported on green runs.
Claiming wired when nothing calls it is the defect this register exists to make impossible.

providerCapabilityClaims (optional) = the provider-capability values this clause's reason asserts, checked against the source that declares them. Added 2026-09-06 (W4U1) after E5-2's reason described artifactExportMode for weeks after PR #353 changed it, because nothing read the sentence.

E3-5-product-approval.reason: JOB-010..014 parity bridge. Zero production callers; the legacy approval path still owns this. Wire when the sinks cut over (Sprint 6, MIG-005/006/007 ACTIVE).

E3-15-budget.reason: Parity bridge with zero callers; budget/cost still flow through the legacy cost-event path. Wire at sink cutover (Sprint 6).

E3-17-output.reason: JOB-014 output projection has zero callers; task_outputs is still written by the legacy path. Wire at sink cutover (Sprint 6).

E3-18-revocation.reason: revokeExecutionTarget writes a pending row, but the fanout that ACTS on it has zero callers, so a revoked target is not actively torn down. Needs a scheduler/consumer; sequence with Sprint 3 (dispatch live) since it only bites once workers run.

E4-1-leases-through-protocol.reason: PROMOTED ON EVIDENCE — Sprint 5 Step 1 (CLI-006/D2). packages/worker-daemon/src/__tests__/composed-journey.component.test.ts drives composeDispatchRuntime with its REAL factories through ONE lease: createPollLoop polls, self-checks the frozen offer, and ACKs over the real lease-ack POST (fake.ackCountFor(lease)===1 for the offered lease), then hands off to a supervised run. This is 'a composed loop that took a lease in this sprint's suite' — never caller count. The traversal is the REAL protocol (real pollOnce, frozen leaseOfferV1Schema, real ackLease, a device proof the counterparty verifies INDEPENDENTLY); the counterparty is the protocol-faithful in-process control-plane double (support/fake-control-plane.ts), not real E2B. The SERVER-side leasing/placement that mints the offer is proven separately on the D1 lane (CLI-006, 40/40) + server/src/__tests__/job-leasing.integration.test.ts. Mutation-proven non-vacuous (CLI-006-D2-step1-result.md §3): M0 (positive control) reddens the whole test; M1 (skip the ACK POST) reddens ONLY this E4-1 lease case while the E4-2 supervise case stays green; M2 (remove the handoff) is the mirror — E4-1 green, E4-2 red. STRENGTHENED by Leg B Part 1 (server/src/__tests__/composed-loop-real-server.integration.test.ts): the SAME createPollLoop leases a REAL server-minted attempt over the REAL embedded-PG worker-control routes (real device proof + session; the server's activateLeaseAck flips the attempt to 'leased' + the lease to 'active' + writes a lease_ack receipt — proven ACK-specific, with a no-candidate negative control + a dist-rebuilt M1). So the counterparty is no longer only the in-process double; the server's real lease reaches the composed worker. The full DISTRIBUTED journey on REAL E2B remains E7-1 (unwired), and the credential resolve over a live fence (Leg B Part 2) is owed.

E4-2-supervises-sandboxes.reason: PROMOTED ON EVIDENCE — Sprint 5 Step 1 (CLI-006/D2). In composed-journey.component.test.ts a REAL ACK (poll-loop trackHandoff after ackLease) reaches createSupervisor, which runs the sandbox lifecycle create -> execute (tenant command INSIDE the sandbox) -> destroy (provider ops === [create,execute,destroy]) and drains a digest-valid terminal event. It also redeems the CLI-007-minted provider_key handle into spec.env (fail-closed when denied). This is an actually-supervised sandbox reached after an ACK — the exact bar this clause named. The sandbox is the per-op fake provider (support/fake-provider.ts, implements SandboxProvider); a REAL E2B sandbox is E7-1 (unwired). Mutation-proven (CLI-006-D2-step1-result.md §3): M2 (remove trackHandoff) reddens ONLY this E4-2 supervise case while the E4-1 lease case stays green; M3 (drop synthesiseRunSecrets) reddens the credential + fail-closed cases; M5 (no-op the drain) isolates the stream.

E4-3-survives-restart.reason: DEFERRED (WRK-008 slice 2b §4.2), for ONE blocker: StartupReconcilerDeps.leaseCandidates (supervisor/startup-reconcile.ts:256-257) has no durable local source — the outbox persists EVENTS, not offers, so the lease-authority probe would run over [] every boot (a guard that passes because it evaluated nothing). ownershipSelector.organizationId is NOT a blocker — it is on the self-model this slice reads and the frozen schema guarantees it non-null for org/owner-scoped targets. E4-3 waits on a durable lease-candidate source (finding E4-F009).

E4-4-event-outbox-replay.reason: Genuinely wired by WRK-008 slice 2b: composeDispatchRuntime opens the outbox store, recovers it (uploading->pending) at composition, and runtime.start() runs drain.start() at boot — independently of leasing or ACK. 'Reachable' here means reachable FROM A BOOT ROOT, not 'runs by default': dispatch is still off by construction (default-OFF flag). True without qualification.

E5-3-patch-quarantine.reason: Zero callers on the DECLARED symbol createPatchApplyService, a server-side DAT-003 service. CORRECTED 2026-09-03: the previous reason reasoned about the SIBLING runOrphanQuarantine (whose producer startup-reconcile is itself uncalled) and concluded the clause is 'blocked on E4 wiring'. That is a substitution, not an addition — the checker reads the caller count of createPatchApplyService, which no E4 daemon ticket touches, so wiring the startup reconciler (WRK-013) flips E4-3-survives-restart and does NOT flip this clause. The GO-BOOK's WRK-013 row inherited the same error and is corrected in the same change.

E5-2-fenced-object-commit-worker-half.reason: DAT-009 slice 3, slice a. The E5 gate says fenced object commit passes in D1, and its SERVER half does: mint (artifact-transfer-grant.ts), commit (artifact-commit.ts) and a real presigned PUT are live-proven on the D1 lane against real MinIO (DAT-002-live-minio-result.md, d1-merge-train 31885553697, 13/13). This clause is deliberately named for the WORKER half, which is the half that has never run: nothing in production sequences digest -> mint upload grant -> export -> commit. Do NOT read this entry as saying the commit path is unbuilt - that substitution is the exact error E5-3-patch-quarantine had to be corrected for. createArtifactExportSequencer has ZERO production callers by construction: its only consumers are its own tests until DAT-009 slice 3c adds the supervisor hook (SupervisorDeps.resolveExportArtifacts) and 3d composes it in dispatch-runtime.ts, following the createStagedInputResolver precedent at E7-1-staged-input-grant. Promote then, with evidence. Note that composing it is NOT sufficient for a byte to move. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (W4U1): the previous sentence asserted that BOTH shipped providers were still at the provider-wire value, citing e2b-provider.ts:178 - a value AND a line that PR #353 invalidated, and that nothing read. Measured at this tip: packages/sandbox-e2b-provider/src/e2b-provider.ts:246 declares artifactExportMode = grant_upload and implements export for real, while packages/provider-wire/src/driver.ts:83 still declares artifactExportMode = none and its digestArtifact (:182-184) and exportArtifact (:185-192) throw UnsupportedProviderOperation UNCONDITIONALLY, never reading the property at all. READ THIS AS A CORRECTION TO THE REGISTER, NOT AS THE PRECONDITION BEING SATISFIED: the networked/container lane still cannot export, slice 3e still owes the wire route, and NOTHING yet produces the ArtifactExportRequest[] the sequencer would consume - that producer is CLI-008 Unit F. The two VALUES above are machine-checked against source by providerCapabilityClaims below; the line numbers deliberately are not (scripts/lib/gate-clause-wiring.mjs says why). This clause therefore does NOT gate, and must not be read as gating, the E7-1 capabilityProven counter, which filters kind=workspace_patch (e7-distributed-run-verifier-store.ts:207).

E5-5-redaction.reason: DAT-008 slice 5 (go-book Sprint 4) gives redaction a real INPUT and a production caller. The old symbol createFenceAwareEgressProxy was the DAT-005 EGRESS proxy (Direction B), which DAT-008's Direction A (env + sandbox_local_only) never uses; re-pointed to the worker function that redeems the handle and returns the values that become per-run canaries. synthesiseRunSecrets is referenced by composeDispatchRuntime (dispatch-runtime.ts) behind the default-OFF flag, and the redaction is PROVEN by a planted-leak test on BOTH streams (supervisor-secret-materialization.test.ts: a seeded secret in a lifecycle log AND in a fence-close network_denied is scrubbed to the marker; an unseeded control leaks it verbatim). What remains for Sprint 5 is a real sandbox authenticating over live E2B (parent DAT-008 design §9 limit 3) — the wiring checker reads caller count, not this field, so that residual lives in the test evidence.

E7-1-coding-journey.reason: TWO one-file construction seams now name E2bSandboxProvider, 2 references each (a ProviderModule interface property + a `new mod.E2bSandboxProvider(...)` construction), 4 total. (a) DEP-010 (Sprint 2): the DESKTOP root packages/worker-keystore/src/bin/sandbox-provider.ts. (b) DEP-012 Slice 3 · Wave β2: the ADAPTER-MANAGER host root packages/adapter-manager/src/bin/adapter-manager.ts, which resolves the provider over the real transport and hands it to createProviderServer. STILL UNWIRED in a shipped boot: (a) requires AOA_WORKER_SANDBOX_PROVIDER=e2b + a composed supervisor loop (deferred); (b) DEP-012 Slice 4+5 added the adapter-manager Dockerfile (docker/adapter-manager) and the staging compose now injects the AM public key + boot envs AND the matched CP mint key, but the image is NOT built/pushed and the staging compose is render-only in CI (operator/C0 builds + `docker compose up`), so nothing starts this bin in a shipped CI boot; the through-the-daemon consumer is DEP-011. The bin fail-closes without the CP public key (β2 §β2.2.1), the matched-pair keypair is smoke-checked at C0 by `pnpm verify:cp-am-keypair` before the canary, and the real E2B connect runs only in the operator-dispatched keyed lane. Promote when the operator builds+deploys the adapter-manager image and DEP-011 wires the daemon consumer. The number is typed out, not computed, so a later reference still fires unwired_but_now_has_caller.

E8-1-sandbox-local-browser.reason: packages/browser-runtime has zero importers and is in no dependency list. The 1 known reference is runner.ts calling it INSIDE the package; runner.ts is the in-guest entrypoint and nothing stages it, so the capability is unreachable despite the non-zero count. Blocked on dispatch (Sprint 3) then BRW-004+ (Sprint 7).

E10-2-legacy-reconciliation.reason: MIG-010 Unit 2.3 (E10-F002). Driven by server/src/cli/reconcile-legacy-resources.ts, exposed as `pnpm reconcile:legacy-resources`. Declared `wired` deliberately and enrolled here for the CLASS, not just the instance: E10-F002 was exactly this symbol's predecessor (reconcileCompanyLegacyResources) plus its store having ZERO non-test callers, and nothing mechanical noticed for the life of MIG-008 -- the crosswalk was never written and canary-preflight answered reconciliation_incomplete for every organization, forever. The guard now fails if that call site is removed. PROVEN TO BITE, not merely declared: renaming the CLI's call reddens check-gate-clause-wiring.mjs with exit 1 (claimed_wired_but_no_caller) and restoring it returns exit 0. SCOPE, STATED HONESTLY: `wired` here means a production, non-test, non-comment caller exists -- which is the whole of what this guard measures. It does NOT mean the canary opens. Unit 2.3 closes E10-F002 only; a lease created after the pass still re-closes the gate (E7-F004) and there is no watermark or reconciliation_stale until Unit 2.4.

E10-2-reconciliation-watermark.reason: MIG-010 Unit 2.4a. The durable marker of a COMPLETED reconciliation pass (legacy_reconciliation_passes, migration 0269) is what Unit 2.4b's canary gate narrows its lease inventory to; without a marker WRITE the gate reads no evidence and refuses reconciliation_stale forever. Enrolled here for the CLASS, exactly as E10-2-legacy-reconciliation was: E10-F002's whole shape was a capability whose production path had zero callers, unnoticed for the life of MIG-008, and a marker writer is the same shape one layer down. `wired` means a production, non-test caller exists -- reconcileOrganizationLegacyResources calls it once per company, after every record for that company is on disk. It does NOT mean the canary opens: nothing READS the marker until Unit 2.4b.

E10-1-drain.reason: MIG-009 FIXED the two correctness defects and proved them at embedded-PG (server/src/__tests__/job-distributed-drain.integration.test.ts): (1) the rollback-safety grain is now per-Company (was assertRollbackSafe(organizationId) against a Company-keyed gate — an interface lie that fails CLOSED against the real bridge; the drain now enumerates every Company under the org via listOrganizationCompanyIds and asserts each, so a pending authoritative-cost receipt on ANY Company skips the whole org, closing the sibling-Company fail-open); (2) the missing listActiveAttempts SQL now exists (server/src/services/job-distributed-drain-store.ts — tenant-scoped runInTenant read, notInArray(TERMINAL), selectDistinct by job). The untested drain statuses (cancelled + no_active_lease) are covered. The drain is CORRECT WHEN WIRED. It stays UNWIRED (zero production callers by design): promoting to wired needs an honest drainAll INVOCATION — a real operator teardown / kill-switch write path — which is REL-005 scope (boot/SIGTERM/sweeper are the WRONG triggers; they'd cancel in-flight work on every restart). Composing createDistributedExecutionDrain in index.ts without a drainAll trigger would flip the caller count to >=1 and force a vacuous 'wired', the exact anti-pattern this register catches. Count stays 0 until REL-005 lands the trigger.

E11-5-provider-kill-switch.reason: Genuinely wired: called on the real poll path (job-leasing.ts) and by the warm-sandbox reaper. Residual, recorded in the wave doc: no write path (throwing it means hand-executed SQL) and it is instance-wide per provider with no Organization or sink dimension - REL-005 scope.

E7-1-staged-input-write.reason: CLI-008 Unit B. `JobArtifactsRepository.insert` had ZERO callers — production OR test — and is the ONLY unguarded write on the inbound artifact path; `stageJobInputFiles` is its production consumer. Referenced from the distributed composition root (server/src/index.ts, `RunExecutionOwnerDeps.stageJobInput`) and invoked by `resolveExecutionOwner` BETWEEN the convert and the placement — the job must exist (the job_artifacts composite FK) and the attempt must not be leasable yet (a worker that leased first would find nothing committed). ★ STATED PLAINLY, because `wired` here means REACHABLE FROM A BOOT ROOT and not 'runs today' (the same sense E4-4 records): the seam currently passes NO files, because Unit B is the CHANNEL and Units C (MCP config) and D (instructions bundle) supply what rides it. So no production run stages a file yet and `capabilityProven` is unmoved. No stub assembler was added to make the count look better — a function that returns [] by construction is the vacuously-true clause this register exists to prevent. The channel ITSELF is proven end to end with a real bundle in server/src/__tests__/cli-008-unit-b-staging-channel.integration.test.ts: a control-plane-authored file is inside the sandbox with the right bytes at the instant the tenant command runs, over embedded PostgreSQL, the real leasing poll, the real artifact_transfer_grant download branch on a real live fence, the real E2B driver and the mock transport's filesystem. Mutation-proven per link (Task 5 Step 2): skipping this insert reds job-input-staging.integration (3/6) while the resolver and provider link tests stay green. The provider half (`SandboxProvider.stageFiles`) is deliberately NOT given its own clause: the symbol is an interface method with references on every implementer, so its count is a weak signal — stage-files.test.ts is what pins it.

E7-1-staged-input-grant.reason: CLI-008 Unit B. `ControlPlaneClient.artifactTransferGrant` had exactly ONE caller in the repo — a unit test (worker-daemon/src/__tests__/artifact-commit-client.test.ts:80). `createStagedInputResolver` is its production consumer: it reads the control plane's staged-input pointer off the frozen envelope's extensions[] and mints one short-lived download grant per file. Referenced once, by `composeDispatchRuntime` (packages/worker-daemon/src/lifecycle/dispatch-runtime.ts), which passes it to the supervisor as `resolveStagedFiles` — the same shape and the same composition point as `materializeRunSecrets`. Reachable from the dispatch boot root; like every other symbol on that root it is behind the default-OFF distributed-execution flag. Grants out, never bytes: nothing here fetches an object, so no payload crosses the dependency-pinned daemon. A run whose envelope carries no pointer resolves to [] and makes no request at all, which is every production run today. Mutation-proven (Task 5 Step 2): skipping the grant mint reds staged-input-resolver.test.ts (7/9) while the control-plane write and the provider link tests stay green — that test was ADDED because the mutation originally reddened only the end-to-end suite, which is the 'proven only at its ends' hole.

E5-6-denied-egress.reason: E5's exit gate names 'denied egress' as its clause 6; the audit (epics/E5-workspaces-secrets/qa/2026-08-24-d0-e5-exit-gate-audit-a1.md) numbers the same seven, and its clauses 2/3/5 are this register's E5-2/E5-3/E5-5, so 6 is the free and correct id. The production symbol for that clause is createFenceAwareEgressProxy (server/src/services/egress-proxy.ts:146) -- the sole consumer of classifyEgressDestination and the only code in the repo that would REFUSE a destination. It has ZERO production callers: egress-proxy.ts is imported by exactly one file in the tree, the integration test server/src/__tests__/egress-proxy.integration.test.ts, and two production comments assert the same (routes/worker-control.ts:160, services/execution-secret-resolve.ts:7). WHY IT WAS MISSING: this clause was carried by E5-5 until DAT-008 slice 5 legitimately RE-POINTED that entry's symbol to synthesiseRunSecrets (Direction A never uses the egress proxy, so the old pairing was wrong). The re-point was correct and the side effect was not: the egress half stopped being DECLARED at all, so from that commit until this entry the register reported nothing about it on green runs, while the library header still lists createFenceAwareEgressProxy among the 17 unprovable clauses the register exists to surface. Re-enrolled honestly rather than left silent. WHAT WOULD HAVE TO CHANGE for 'wired': some production path must call this proxy. BRW-004 slice (f) is the only chartered candidate, is unattempted, and is browser-scoped; the org/crew sandbox egress path that E8-F003 measured has no chartered owner at all. DO NOT read the D1 grade as evidence for this symbol: the audit grades clause 6 proven_in_d1 on tests/d1/e6f-08-egress-isolation.test.mjs, which proves denial by docker-compose `internal: true` network segmentation around a container ANALOG (worker-a plus fake-provider) and never touches this symbol or the real provider -- and E8-F003 measured the real E2B provider REACHING the identical targets (169.254.169.254 answered HTTP 401; a non-allowlisted public host returned 200).
